page.overview:
Who is Ganon?

Ending credits (most games)}} Ganon (ガノン Ganon), also known as the Prince of Darkness, Demon King, Great King of Evil, Dark Beast, or by his human form Ganondorf,

Usually, but not always, Ganon himself is the Final Boss in the core series, but is playable in spin-off appearances, often as his human form Ganondorf.

In stark contrast to Link and Zelda, in spite of his various different forms in some games, Ganon does not have many incarnations throughout Hyrule's history. Being a demon, the Dark Beast is in fact an endless reincarnation of another antagonist, Demise, from .

Being one of Nintendo's flagship villains and a central character in one of the company's most successful franchises, Ganon is easily recognized and often considered to be one of the most iconic video game primary antagonists of all-time.

Also known as: Demon King, Calamity Ganon.
